summary: Comprehensive testing of Unified Patients feature - Major refactoring. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for navigation, patients page, expandable rows, 13-item checklist, auto-generated tasks, search/filter functionality.
seed_data_creation: Test patients created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified Patients feature is fully implemented and working. Navigation reduced to 4 tabs (Tasks removed). New 13-item pre-op checklist works with toggle API. Auto-generate tasks checkbox creates 6 default tasks. Test patients 'Test New Format' (NEWPAT001) and 'John Quick Test' (JQT2026001) have the new checklist format.

navigation_4_tabs.details: Desktop sidebar has Dashboard, Calendar, Patients, Surgery Timeline, Bulk Import, Settings. Tasks tab is REMOVED. Mobile nav has 4 tabs: Home, Calendar, Patients, Settings.

patients_page_unified_view.details: Patients page shows all patients with columns: Patient (name, MRN), Diagnosis, Procedure, Status, Pre-Op progress bar, Tasks count, Surgery date.

stats_cards.details: Stats cards show Total (8), Add-On (4), Scheduled (0), With Tasks (2) - counts are correct.

expandable_patient_rows.details: Clicking patient row expands to show Patient Details, Pre-Op Checklist (13 items), Tasks list, Activity Log sections.

13_item_preop_checklist.details: New patients have 13-item checklist: H&P Complete, Labs Ordered, Labs Reviewed, Imaging Ordered, Imaging Reviewed, Consent Signed, Prior Authorization Approved, VSP Complete, Anesthesia Clearance, Medical Optimization Complete, Blood Bank, Patient Instructions Given, OR Scheduled.

checklist_toggle_api.details: PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/preop-checklist/{item_id} toggles checklist items. Progress updates immediately (0/13 -> 1/13 = 8%).

auto_generate_tasks.details: POST /api/patients/create-with-tasks with auto_generate_tasks=true creates 6 tasks: H&P, Surgical Consent, Insurance Prior Auth, Labs, Anesthesia Eval, VSP.

patient_status_workflow.details: Patient without date gets status='add-on'. Patient with date gets status='scheduled'.

search_functionality.details: Search by name and MRN works. Filters patients in real-time.

filter_functionality.details: Filters work: All Status, Add-On, Scheduled, Has Pending Tasks. Dropdown filters update patient list.

add_task_button.details: + Add Task button visible in expanded patient view. Opens inline task creation form.

quick_add_form.details: Quick Add Patient form has 'Auto-generate pre-op tasks' checkbox (checked by default). Uses POST /api/patients/create-with-tasks endpoint.

mobile_responsive.details: Mobile view (390px) shows 4-tab bottom navigation. Stats cards display in 2x2 grid. Patient cards are responsive.

task_toggle_delete.details: PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/toggle marks tasks complete/incomplete. DELETE /api/tasks/{id} removes tasks.

notes: All features from the refactoring are working correctly. The Tasks tab has been successfully removed from navigation. The new UnifiedPatients component with expandable rows is functioning well. The 13-item pre-op checklist and auto-generated tasks are properly integrated with the backend APIs.
